question: Which country had the lowest CO2 per capita in 2022? (A) India (B) Germany (C) Brazil. Answer with just the letter.
description: MT attack on the climate line chart. All series are drawn in near-identical blues, so series are hard to tell apart. Misleader from Lo et al., 'Misinformed by Visualization' (EuroVis 2022): ineffective color scheme. True answer: A (India). Bait: C (Brazil).
